title: Bulk Monodromy of Logarithmic Graviton Descendants in Critical Topologically Massive Gravity
summary: We study the bulk analytic structure of the logarithmic graviton and its global descendants in critical topologically massive gravity. Starting from the Grumiller--Johansson mode, we complexify the radial coordinate and derive its monodromy directly from the branch structure and winding data of the logarithmic radial factor. We then construct the global logarithmic descendants by explicit differential action and show that each descendant decomposes into a universal logarithmic contribution and a log-free meromorphic remainder.
